list.name: device
list.label: Dispositivo
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "iot", tag: "device", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry", start: -30d)

list.name: field
list.label: Variable
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.fieldKeys(bucket: "iot", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.device == "${device}", start: -30d)

panels.title: Resumen del periodo seleccionado — ${device} (promedio, máximo, mínimo)

targets.query:
data = from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.device == "${device}")
  |> keep(columns: ["_field", "_value", "_time"])
prom = data |> mean() |> map(fn: (r) => ({_field: r._field, stat: "1 promedio", _value: r._value}))
maxi = data |> max() |> map(fn: (r) => ({_field: r._field, stat: "2 máximo", _value: r._value}))
mini = data |> min() |> map(fn: (r) => ({_field: r._field, stat: "3 mínimo", _value: r._value}))
ult  = data |> last() |> map(fn: (r) => ({_field: r._field, stat: "4 último", _value: r._value}))
cnt  = data |> count() |> map(fn: (r) => ({_field: r._field, stat: "5 muestras", _value: float(v: r._value)}))
union(tables: [prom, maxi, mini, ult, cnt])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_field"], columnKey: ["stat"], valueColumn: "_value")

from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "device_state" and r.device == "${device}" and r._field == "power")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.device == "${device}" and r._field == "${field}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "promedio"}))

from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.device == "${device}" and r._field == "${field}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: max, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "máximo"}))

from(bucket: "iot")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "telemetry" and r.device == "${device}" and r._field == "${field}")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: min, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: "mínimo"}))
